title: Parties must reduce agreement to writing
description: Parties to a consumer dispute must reduce their agreement to writing

content.who: Parties to a consumer dispute or their authorised representatives
content.what: must reduce the terms of the agreement to writing and sign it
conditions: an agreement is reached between the parties with respect to all or some of the issues involved in the consumer dispute
